Billy Joel - The 100th. Live At Madison Square Garden (2026) Blu-ray



Dubbed as the "greatest arena run of all time”, the iconic 100th performance of Billy Joel's Madison Square Garden residency was immortalized on March 28th, 2024. This electrifying spectacle was expertly helmed by director Paul Dugdale and Enliven Entertainment, offering a captivating and immersive glimpse into this monthly phenomenon. With a staggering 18,000 fans in attendance, Billy Joel bestowed upon them an evening to "forget about life for a while." The concert was meticulously captured in stunning 4K resolution and enveloping 5.1 audio, transporting viewers into the very heart of the performance. Backed by his extraordinary 7-piece band, Billy Joel breathed new life into his timeless classics, infusing each note with humor and humility. From beloved hits to hidden gems, and even featuring a few surprise guests, the experience crafted an unparalleled viewing journey, commemorating a milestone that comes once in a lifetime.
